title.narrative: Strengthening the role of civil society and building sustainable cooperation in promoting gender equality in Uzbekistan.

description.narrative: The overall objective is achieved through the comprehensive, integrated empowerment and capacity-building of community-based womens rights organizations, building collaboration between the state and non-state actors, and fostering establishment of a CSOs network which will collectively work on improving legal frameworks and policies related to sexual violence in order to address the issue of access of women and girls to justice.
